1先说结论

The short version: six things the best skin-scan videos have in common
🔍
「自测肤质」比「介绍仪器」火得多。大家真正想看的不是一台机器长什么样，而是「我到底是什么皮」。所以最猛的一条是洗脸自测，第二条是用手机相册把自拍拍成一张检测图——两条都不需要任何设备。你们的机器要能回答这个问题，而不是站在旁边当道具。 People want a verdict, not a device tour. What viewers want is not what the machine looks like but the answer "what skin type am I". The two biggest posts in this set are a wash-your-face self-test and a phone-album trick that fakes a scan image — neither uses any hardware. Your device should be the thing that gives the verdict, not a prop standing next to it.

Pull clarity, contrast, black point and sharpness to +100 in the phone album and an ordinary selfie turns into an orange "skin scan". Two of the biggest videos use exactly this: a 21-second one at 105K likes and an 84-second talking version at 51K. Viewers recognise the look of a scan, not the hardware — so your real scan screen has to look better and more believable than this.

这是「收藏型」内容，不是「娱乐型」。测肤、肤质、护肤流程的收藏率高得离谱：一条 137 秒的自测视频收藏是点赞的 74%，一条 17 秒的毛孔特写收藏比点赞还多。观众把它当工具存下来，下次洗脸的时候照着做。所以别怕长、别怕讲步骤，怕的是没有可照着做的动作。 This category gets saved, not just liked. Saves run absurdly high here: a 137-second self-test gets 74% as many saves as likes, and a 17-second pore close-up gets more saves than likes. Viewers keep it as a tool to follow next time they wash their face. So length and step-by-step are fine — what kills a post is having no action to copy.

212 种拍法，每种怎么拍

The 12 formats: a main example, a smaller example of the same idea, and how to make it with your product
1

洗完脸，等十分钟Wash, wait ten minutes, label your zones

一分钱不花、不用任何设备的一版：洗完脸什么都不涂，等十分钟，按额头、脸颊、下巴分区看油光和紧绷，最后落到一句结论。这是全组收藏率最高的类型之一——5 万赞里有 3.3 万是收藏。

The no-device version: wash, touch nothing, wait ten minutes, then read the shine and the tightness on forehead, cheeks and chin, and land on one verdict. One of the most-saved formats in the set — 33K of its 50K likes became saves.

One person, one bathroom wall, one graphic overlay. Take from it: the verdict is a word on screen — 干皮健康肌 / 油皮健康肌 — not a number.

🎬 用你们的测肤镜这样拍How to film it with your own device

机位Setup
手机立在洗手台，略低于视线，竖屏 9:16。背景只留白墙或浴室门，别让瓶瓶罐罐抢镜。Phone on the sink, a little below eye level, vertical 9:16. A blank wall or the bathroom door behind — no bottles stealing the frame.
字幕Captions
「洗完脸什么都别涂 / 等十分钟 / 额头油、脸颊干 = 混干皮」
"Wash and put nothing on / wait ten minutes / oily forehead, dry cheeks = combination-dry".
顺序Order
  1. 洗完脸，只用毛巾按干wash, pat dry only
  2. 画面里出现计时器，等十分钟put a timer on screen, wait ten minutes
  3. 手指按额头、鼻翼、脸颊、下巴各一下tap forehead, nose, cheek, chin once each
  4. 叠分区图，一个区一句话overlay the zone map, one line per zone
  5. 给出结论「你是 X 皮」land on "you are an X skin"
时长Length
95–110 秒。想更短就只留额头和脸颊两个区，40 秒也成立。95–110 seconds. For a short cut, keep only forehead and cheek — 40 seconds works.
别做Don't
别在开头就说产品名。先把问题摆出来（我到底是什么皮），机器在后面出场。Don't say the product name at the start. Put the question first — what skin type am I — and let the device walk in later.

🎬 用你们的测肤镜这样拍How to film it with your own device

机位Setup
前置镜头，脸占满画面，顶光或窗光正打。背景越空越好。Front camera, face filling the frame, light straight on from a window. The emptier the background the better.
参数Sliders
  1. 鲜明度 +100vividness +100
  2. 高光 −100highlights −100
  3. 阴影 −100shadows −100
  4. 对比度 +100contrast +100
  5. 黑点 +100black point +100
  6. 锐化 +100sharpen +100
  7. 清晰度 +100clarity +100
字幕Captions
「不花钱的皮肤检测 / 右滑看参数 / 你的脸会是这个颜色」
"A free skin scan / swipe for the sliders / your face will look like this".
顺序Order
  1. 素颜正脸 2 秒bare face, 2s
  2. 开始拉参数，一档一行字幕pull the sliders, one caption per slider
  3. 脸变成橙黄色后停住 1 秒hold one second when the face goes orange
  4. 推到鼻翼/脸颊局部push into nose or cheek
  5. 最后打出完整参数表end on the full parameter table
时长Length
20–30 秒，参数那一段不能超过 8 秒。20–30 seconds; the slider section must not run past 8 seconds.

道具Props

🎬 用你们的测肤镜这样拍How to film it with your own device

机位Setup
手持为主，一半镜头给产品、一半给镜子里的脸；户外用自然光，室内用窗光。Mostly handheld: half the shots on the product, half on the face in the mirror. Daylight outdoors, window light indoors.
字幕Captions
「她问我在哪买的 / 镜子里能看见没涂到的地方 / 送人不踩雷」
"She asked where I got it / the mirror shows what you missed / a gift that doesn't miss".
顺序Order
  1. 别人拿起它、惊讶的一下someone picks it up and reacts
  2. 产品开合 2 秒open and close it, 2s
  3. 镜子里自己的脸 + 一个斑点区your face in it plus one spot area
  4. 室内 1 个场景 + 户外 1 个场景one indoor scene, one outdoor
  5. 一句「送人合适」one line: "good gift"
时长Length
60–90 秒。礼物类内容可以长，因为购买者会看到最后。60–90 seconds. Gift content can run long — buyers watch to the end.
别做Don't
别承诺检测结论。镜子能「照出来」和「诊断」是两件事，说前者。Don't promise a diagnosis. A mirror can show you something; that is not the same as diagnosing it.

4每种拍法都用得上的 7 个镜头

Seven shots that work in every format
  • 屏幕必须对镜头。这个品类 90% 的价值在那块屏上。拍的时候把屏幕转向镜头，让人能读清一行字；读不清就重拍，别靠字幕解释。Turn the screen to the lens. Ninety percent of the value is on that screen. Angle it at the camera until one line is readable — if it isn't, shoot it again rather than explaining it in captions.
  • 先给结论，再给过程。「你是混干皮」这句话放在前 3 秒，观众才会留下来看机器怎么得出来的。Verdict first, process second. "You're combination-dry" in the first three seconds is what keeps people watching to see how the machine got there.
  • 一张真实检测图，比十句形容词有用。裁一块原始检测图（毛孔、色斑、泛红）贴到画面上，别美化，别磨皮。One real scan crop beats ten adjectives. Crop one square of the raw scan — pores, pigment, redness — and put it on screen. No beauty filter, no smoothing.
  • 拍一次「拆下来」的过程。不管是卸妆棉、拔下探头还是摘下镜子，观众想看你把设备从脸上拿开之后，脸是什么样。Film the taking-off. A cotton pad, a probe coming off, the mirror going down — viewers want to see the face after the device leaves it.
  • 同一个人，同一盏灯，拍「之前」和「之后」。灯光、角度、背景三样必须一样，否则对比不算数，评论区会立刻指出来。Same person, same lamp, before and after. Light, angle and background must match, or the comparison doesn't count and the comments will say so.
  • 把「懒」拍出来。大家关心的是「我能不能坚持」。拍你躺在床上、边刷手机边测，比拍你端坐在梳妆台前更可信。Show the laziness. People care whether they'll keep it up. Filming it in bed, phone in the other hand, is more believable than sitting upright at a vanity.
  • 结尾留一个可复制的问题。「你测出来是什么皮？评论区告诉我」——这条会决定一半的评论量。End on a question worth answering. "What did yours come out as? Tell me below" — that single line decides half your comment count.
所有视频：竖屏 9:16，手机原生相机，白天窗边光。测肤类画面最怕顶光（会在眼下、鼻翼打黑影），灯放在正前方略高一点。皮肤要干净、不涂任何东西，指甲修好——镜头离脸只有 20 厘米的时候，这些都会被看见。All videos: vertical 9:16, the phone's own camera, daylight from a window. Skin-scan footage hates overhead light — it throws shadows under the eyes and beside the nose. Put the light in front and slightly high. Clean skin, nothing on it, tidy nails: at 20 cm from the lens, all of it shows.

6我们怎么找的

How we found these

2026 年 11 月 19 日，抖音搜了 26 个关键词、小红书搜了 26 个：AI测肤、测肤仪、皮肤检测仪、肌肤检测、皮肤测试、测肤报告、智能美妆镜、化妆镜、肤质测试、皮肤分析、皮肤管理、毛孔检测、色斑检测、美容仪测评、家用美容仪、熬夜脸、烂脸修复、敏感肌、油痘肌、抗老护肤、护肤vlog、护肤测评、免费测肤、商场测肤、黑科技护肤、变美日记。都按点赞排序。一共排了 1258 条测肤 / 美妆镜内容（抖音 434、小红书 824），挑出 35 条逐条看完。去掉的：影视剧剪辑和 AI 拼的科普片、商家自己的直播和门店账号（包括唯一一条门店检测仪宣传片）、与测肤无关的同名视频（熬夜科普、祛痘药膏带货）、以及「3S 自测冷暖皮」里重复的搬运号（只留了三条真正在复拍的）。品牌植入的内容我们标成「品牌植入」，因为无法确认是否付费。

On 2026-11-19 we ran 26 Douyin and 26 Xiaohongshu searches, sorted by most likes, and ranked 1,258 skin-scan and mirror posts (434 Douyin, 824 Xiaohongshu); 35 were watched all the way through. Left out: drama clips and AI-stitched science videos, shops' own livestream and store accounts (including the only store-scanner promo), unrelated posts sharing a keyword (sleep-science, acne-cream selling), and the duplicated reposts of the 3-second undertone test — only three that were genuinely re-filmed were kept. Sponsored-looking posts are marked "brand placement", because we can't confirm they were paid.
